draw_index_semantics.note: column j is the same iteration of one row's stream for every metric of that row, so cross-metric dependence on this axis is real. Rows are seeded independently, so a CROSS-ROW correlation read off the same axis measures the generator's lack of coupling, not a football quantity.

qb.rng_stream: numpy default_rng([seed, ord, gsis_id]) -- one stream per row; columns are aligned, rows are independent

receiving.rng_stream: P4C simplex allocation and RC1 conversion on the shared game draw index

rushing.rng_stream: P4C simplex allocation over the A1 running-back budget on the shared game draw index
